data.title: Kitchen and Yard Matter Adventure
data.description: Let us discover how solids, liquids, and gases make up everything around us!

objects.name: rock
objects.imagePrompt: A smooth gray rock sitting on green grass outdoors

objects.name: water
objects.imagePrompt: Clear water splashing inside a glass cup

objects.name: air
objects.imagePrompt: An open sunny blue sky with soft white clouds

objects.name: honey
objects.imagePrompt: Golden honey dripping slowly from a wooden honey dipper

objects.name: sand
objects.imagePrompt: A handful of sparkly golden beach sand in bright sunlight

objects.name: steam
objects.imagePrompt: Gentle white steam rising up from a hot mug of soup

challenges.instruction: Is the rock a solid, a liquid, or a gas?
challenges.narration: I wonder why this heavy rock stays the exact same shape wherever we put it!

challenges.instruction: Is the water a solid, a liquid, or a gas?
challenges.narration: Look at how this water slides and takes the shape of its cup! Is it a solid, liquid, or gas?

challenges.instruction: Is the air a solid, a liquid, or a gas?
challenges.narration: We cannot see it, but we can feel it when the wind blows. What state of matter is air?

challenges.instruction: Is the honey a solid, a liquid, or a gas?
challenges.narration: Even though it moves so slowly and feels thick, let us figure out if honey is a solid, liquid, or gas!
